environment.description: WebSocket chat service deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. Logs are shipped to CloudWatch via fluentd agent and parsed line-by-line. SIEM alerts trigger on specific log patterns (e.g., 'ERROR.*SQL', 'CRITICAL.*auth'). No input sanitization middleware or reverse proxy in front of the service.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, EIP attached to instance
config.log_pipeline: fluentd -> CloudWatch Logs -> SIEM pattern matching
config.deployment: bare EC2, systemd service, no reverse proxy
